title: Mixed-topology real SWAP live MODFLOW6 application qualification
goal: Qualify one mixed live topology in which two real SWAP columns are aggregated N:1 into groundwater cell 7001 while a third real SWAP column couples 1:1 to groundwater cell 7002, all inside one MODFLOW6 6.8.0 prepared solve and one timestep.
decisions: Use three unique SWAP lineages and three independent interface ledgers.
Cell 7001 reuses the F-GC45 homogeneous two-tile N:1 envelope with fractions 0.35/0.65.
Cell 7002 reuses the F-GC44/F-GC46 one-column 1:1 envelope.
Use one F-GC40 cell response per groundwater cell and F-GC34 package slots 1/2 mapped to distinct MODFLOW nodes.
Correctors for the two cell-7001 tiles receive the same cell-7001 head; the cell-7002 tile receives only the cell-7002 head.
Coupled convergence requires MODFLOW convergence plus both cell-level flux residuals within tolerance.
All three SWAP candidates and ledgers preflight before the single MODFLOW finalize_time_step; publication is MODFLOW then SWAPs then ledgers in canonical cell/tile order.
next_permitted_action: F-GC47 is closed. Further useful groundwater work now branches materially: production-grade generic topology orchestration, numerical/physics-envelope expansion, or SCALE heterogeneous-transferability science. Choose that direction explicitly rather than extending synthetic topology coverage by default.
